content.short: Tand3m is a decentralized launchpad on TON focusing on fair price discovery and secure fundraising.
content.description: Tand3m is a specialized decentralized launchpad on the TON blockchain that operates under a 'Fair By Design' philosophy. It utilizes innovative Liquidity Bootstrapping Pools (LBPs) to ensure fair price discovery and prevent bot manipulation during token launches. Tand3m supports a wide range of fundraising models, including NFT-based pre-sales and fixed-price rounds, all executed through audited smart contracts. By prioritizing backer safety and market fairness, Tand3m provides a reliable and transparent environment for early-stage investment in the TON network.
